limit_notes.literal_0_1: Zero/default, positivity and sentinel semantics are retained as literals; focused source predicates cover nontrivial bounds.
limit_notes.negative_bounds: ASCII minus and Unicode minus are both checked as signed values.
limit_notes.efficiency_scale: 10,000 = 100% is a unit convention, not a separately adjustable bound.
limit_notes.item_pipe_overflow: Long.MAX_VALUE / 100 and Integer.MAX_VALUE / 4 are described, not expanded as decimal table limits.
limit_notes.recipe_table_relations: Cross-field comparisons, not numeric constants; source predicates are covered separately.
limit_notes.name_patterns_and_runtime_strings: Pattern and runtime-only checks have explicit source checks in the checker.
